chunks: Aban meriwayatkan dari Abd al-Rahman, dari Abu Abdillah (alamah), yang berkata:

Ketika anak kecil mencuri dan belum mencapai baligh, ujung jarinya dipotong. Ia berkata: Rasulullah (shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam) adalah satu-satunya yang melakukan hal ini, dan aku [juga melakukannya].

key_terms.يَحْتَلِم: Mencapai masa pubertas (khususnya melalui mimpi basah)

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a child who steals before reaching puberty in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that the hadd punishment for theft in a pre-pubescent boy (sabiy) involves amputating the tips of the fingers rather than the hand, a ruling uniquely attributed to the Prophet and Imam al-Sadiq (AS). This distinction highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the full hand amputation applies only upon reaching maturity, while the child receives a lesser corporal penalty as a form of discipline and deterrence.
